head: fix/story-2-8-maintenance-registration
title: ci: register the 4.44 maintenance publisher
body:
Register the retained G4 publisher filename on the default branch so GitHub can dispatch the reviewed 4.44.x maintenance workflow. This declaration has no repository permissions and always refuses publication when executed from the default branch.

Delivered under the reviewed maintenance policy in https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd/pull/1 (owner source 3c285357c9eadec74a3516d649c8197fe1719052). The change is one workflow file; ordinary main releases retain their existing entry point.

Validation: canonical owner template/hash checks, 17 owner delivery/environment controls, and the owning locked commitlint policy. Normal source CI must complete before delivery; this PR creates no release or tag.
